subject: Decision Making
title: The Nudge Unit
description: A quick win: understand The Nudge Unit.

hook.text: In 2010, the UK government created a team to change behavior without passing new laws. They called it the Nudge Unit.

buildup.text: The Behavioural Insights Team tested tiny changes: adding a personal name to tax letters, simplifying forms.

discovery.text: Results stunned Whitehall. A single line in tax letters raised on-time payment by millions of pounds. Cost: nearly zero.

twist.text: The team was set to close if it did not save 10 times its cost. It saved 300 times its cost in the first two years.

climax.text: Over 200 governments worldwide now operate nudge units. Behavioral science became an official policy tool.

punchline.text: One line in a tax letter raised millions. Nudging became policy.

quiz.question: What was the UK Nudge Unit's key approach?
options: Testing small behavioral changes in government communications to improve compliance
